new_defect_types.name: emission_source_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: A flow or emission the prompt ties to a specific part (rain from a spout, smoke from a chimney, light from a lamp) comes from the wrong part of the object, or from several parts, while the intended outlet is inert.
examples: orig448/qwen_image_2p1_pe: a water torrent pours from a hole in the bottom of the pot, spout dry
orig448/fibo2_dev: rain drips from the base of the pot
orig448/flux3_klein_base, qwen_image_2p1_nope: rain curtain falls from the whole underside, not the spout
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A12 cause/effect covers 'fire gives light' but not 'the effect comes from the right outlet'; B03 is the only fallback and gives no Layer-A signal when there is no prompt.

new_defect_types.name: embedded_data_inconsistency (maps/charts/screens)
new_defect_types.description: Information rendered inside a map, chart or UI contradicts itself or plain geography: legend range vs labels, scale bar vs the land shown, identical values repeated across different terrain, feature labels in the wrong place, a route crossing land, duplicated map furniture.
examples: phi80/gpt_image_2: legend -4100…-6200 m but labels read -6800 m
phi80/qwen_image_2p1_pe: 1:250,000 / 25 nm scale with all of Cuba on screen
phi80/fibo2_dev: cable runs over land; deep-water labels on the shallow shelf
phi80/krea2_turbo: two north arrows, '20m' ocean depths
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A10 says only 'does every diagram make sense', with circuit/UI examples. Judges don't know whether world-knowledge or geographic errors count, or how to grade them; A18 covers only alignment and layout.

new_defect_types.name: functional_part_misplacement
new_defect_types.description: A tool or vessel has its functional parts in a non-working arrangement, e.g. handle and spout on the same side, or a vessel with an extra opening.
examples: orig448/flux3_klein: teapot handle arcs directly above the spout on the same side
orig323/qwen_image_2p1_pe: one-sided ring flap on a mushroom stalk
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: It falls under A10, but A10's examples are all machines and UI. Adding 'part arrangement on everyday objects (handles, spouts, lids)' would make judges look for it.

rubric_issues.problem: When a prompt asks for one uniform medium (e.g. 'entire artwork pointillist') and the model applies it to the background only, both A15 (style leak) and B05 fire for the same pixels. The rubric doesn't say whether to double-record or which one sets severity.
examples: orig323/fibo2_dev: realistic-fur panda over a dotted sky
orig323/qwen_image_2p1_pe: near-photo grass under a painted sky
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Record A15 when elements differ in medium from each other. Record B05 when the whole image misses the requested medium (orig323/gemini, ideogram). If both apply, put the severity on A15 and mark B05 'partial'.

rubric_issues.criterion: A02 vs A03 for requested-but-unspecified text
rubric_issues.problem: The prompt asks for 'cardboard signs and banners' but gives no wording. Is gibberish sign text A02 (part of the design) or A03 (incidental)? The signs are focal in a protest scene.
examples: phi449/fibo2_dev: 'DESTIIOR / INPAR PE'
phi449/flux3_klein: banner 'RFOD…'
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Requested text carriers whose wording is unspecified go to A03, at moderate severity when they sit in the focal area. A02 stays for text whose wording is specified, or for text that is the subject.

rubric_issues.problem: A09 could fire on an object caught mid-fall (krea apple). In a photo that is a legitimate frozen-motion moment.
examples: orig80/krea2_turbo: apple frozen mid-air
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add an exclusion: objects plausibly in motion (falling, thrown, splashing droplets) are not A09. Check only whether the motion is consistent.

rubric_issues.problem: Strong models fill scenes with real-world names (YMCA, Universal Robots, Dell, Mitutoyo, Hawaiki, SF Muni routes, Portland street signs). C01 gives no severity guidance or threshold.
examples: phi449/gpt_image_2: YMCA, '49 VAN NESS/MISSION'
phi328/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: UR logo
phi80/gpt_image_2_quality_high: 'Hawaiki Cable'
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Split C01 into C01a, a logo or brand mark on the focal object, and C01b, an incidental real name or street sign. Report C01b only, with no severity.

rubric_issues.problem: It is unclear whether the unit must appear on every label or only in the legend.
examples: phi80/gpt_image_2_quality_high: legend 'Depth (m)', bare labels
phi80/flux3_klein: no unit anywhere
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: The unit is satisfied if a legend or axis title states it. Flag only when no unit appears anywhere.

rubric_issues.problem: 'A frame hanging in the center' could mean the centre of the wall or the centre of the image. Most models put the frame right of the image centre to make room for the vases.
examples: orig562/flux3_klein, gpt_image_2, krea2_turbo
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Read placement words relative to the named reference object (here the wall). Do not flag when the reference extends beyond the frame.

false_positive_traps.description: Dashcam on-screen timestamp and fisheye or dark lens vignette when the prompt asks for a dashcam view. Under A16 these could be flagged as a 'subtitle bar' or 'vignette frame', but they belong to the requested capture device.
examples: phi449/ideogram4_nf4: timestamp + circular vignette

false_positive_traps.description: Unrequested on-theme props and signage (a Principia book next to Newton, safety signs in a scrapyard, lab signs). B07 should not fire; they serve the scene.
examples: orig80/gpt_image_2: 'PHILOSOPHIAE NATURALIS PRINCIPIA MATHEMATICA' book
orig200/gpt_image_2: 'SAFETY IS NOT OPTIONAL'

false_positive_traps.description: Requested haze or glare that softens the image is not A21/A23.
examples: phi449/qwen_image_2p1_nope: hazy sunlit crowd
phi80/flux3_klein_base: diagonal glare streak on the monitor

false_positive_traps.description: Asymmetric but buildable designs (different-coloured pontoons, robots with no head) are not A10.
examples: phi208/flux3_klein: one white and one orange pontoon
orig200/flux3_klein: headless robot with a claw arm
